title: True Romance
tagline: Kung fu triple feature. Pie after.
about: A comic shop clerk marries a call girl and the two go on the run to Hollywood with a suitcase they shouldn't have.

cheddar and cayenne.Pipe small rounds.Bake at 200°C until puffed and hollow.Detroit Coney dog slidersClarence's Detroit, before the road tripHow to make itAs written, serves 4Griddled cocktail franks in steamed mini rolls under a fine, spicy beef chilli sauce, yellow mustard and plenty of diced raw onion.Brown 250g fine beef mince with half a finely diced onion, breaking it up very small.Add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 20 minutes into a loose sauce.Griddle 16 cocktail franks until blistered.Steam 16 mini rolls for 1 minute.Fill once in the oil.Grill the bacon and toast the bread.Layer chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise across three slices each and cut into triangles.Fry the fries a second time until crisp.Steve's double smash burgersThe biggest, fattest burger on their menu.How to make itAs written, serves 4Two crispy smashed chuck patties with American cheese, onion, pickles and burger sauce in soft buns,
